scripts.web: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['web','server'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});for(const f of ['index.html','gwen-games.js','levels.js','levels.css','icon.svg','manifest.json'])fs.cpSync('../'+f,'web/'+f);fs.cpSync('icon.png','web/icon.png');fs.cpSync('../netlify/functions','server/functions',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('../netlify/lib','server/lib',{recursive:true})"
scripts.dist: npm run web && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
